page.title: Budget and maintenance costs
page.description: Budget, commitments, actuals and forecast by cost centre, fed by closed work orders.

reason.no_cost_center: No cost centre for this work order.
reason.no_budget_version: No approved budget version for the year.
reason.currency_mismatch: The budget currency differs from the company currency.
reason.period_closed: Every remaining period of the year is closed.
reason.no_currency: The company currency is not configured.
reason.no_fiscal_calendar: The fiscal-year start month is not configured.
reason.unpriced_labor: Some recorded hours have no hourly rate.

fix.no_cost_center: Set the cost centre on the asset (or its location), or choose one in the work order estimate, then retry the settlement.
fix.no_budget_version: Create and approve the year's budget (Budget tab), then retry the settlement.
fix.currency_mismatch: Create a budget version in the company currency, then retry the settlement.
fix.period_closed: Reopen a period of the year (Period close tab), then retry the settlement.
fix.no_currency: Set the currency in Settings › Localization, then retry the settlement.
fix.unknown: Retry the settlement; if it stays pending, contact the administrator.
fix.no_fiscal_calendar: Choose the fiscal-year start month in Settings › Localization, then retry the settlement.
fix.unpriced_labor: Enter the hourly rate on the time entries concerned, or create a rate card for the technician in force on the work date (Personnel), then retry the settlement.

settlements.intro: Each closed work order — or one cancelled after consuming labour, parts or services — is settled once to the cost centre and period of its close. If a settled work order's cost changes later (a receipt, issue, return or time entry arriving after the close, even one recorded offline before it), only the difference with what is already settled is added. A pending settlement says what to fix; reopening a work order reverses its settlement.
